about_the_game:
DEADLIST

DEADLIST is a psychological survival horror adventure that puts you in the role of Thalarius, a paranormal investigator trapped in the cursed Black Forest. What begins as a search for answers quickly turns into a fight for survival against an environment that bends reality itself.

Explore, survive, and uncover the forest’s dark secrets before you are consumed by fear and madness.

Gameplay Features

Exploration & Discovery

Search the haunted forest for journals, relics, and clues left behind by past victims. Every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth.

Survival Mechanics

Manage limited resources such as food and flashlight batteries. Every decision matters when supplies are scarce.

Dynamic World

Paths shift, landmarks disappear, and the forest actively works against you, creating a tense and unpredictable experience each time you play.

Paranormal Encounters

Experience hallucinations, whispers, and ghostly figures that blur the line between reality and nightmare. Some will stalk you, others will test your sanity.

Procedural Labyrinths

Escape randomly generated underground mazes where time is your enemy. Stay too long and paranoia takes over.

Choice & Consequence

Multiple endings depending on whether you fight to escape or sacrifice yourself to end the curse once and for all.

Playtime

A full playthrough can take up to 4 hours, depending on how much you explore and how you approach survival. The procedural labyrinth and multiple endings.

pegi.descriptors: This game contains psychological horror elements, disturbing imagery, and themes of fear, paranoia, and death. Players may encounter depictions of ghostly figures, supernatural violence, references to ritual sacrifice, and self-harm in the context of the story. It does not include sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or drug use, but players who are sensitive to horror, mental instability, or themes of suicide should take caution
